scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cchistory/domain build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/source-adapters build && pnpm --filter @cchistory/storage build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import ../../scripts/install-node-sqlite-warning-filter.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/app.test.js
scripts.test:managed: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import ../../scripts/install-node-sqlite-warning-filter.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-skip-pattern='remote agent' dist/app.test.js
scripts.test:agent-extension: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import ../../scripts/install-node-sqlite-warning-filter.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='remote agent' dist/app.test.js
